raw.details:
About the Competition

C Code Auction Arena 2026 is an exciting C programming competition that combines programming knowledge, logical thinking, problem-solving skills, and strategic bidding. Featuring two engaging rounds, this competition challenges participants to demonstrate their C programming fundamentals and compete in a unique auction-based coding arena.

Total Prize Pool: ₹7,000

Get ready to test your coding skills, make strategic bids, and prove that you can code under pressure!

Competition Structure

Round 1: C Programming MCQ Qualifier

  • Participants will attempt 20 multiple-choice questions based on C programming.
  • Rankings will be determined by the number of correct answers.
  • In case of a tie, the participant who completes the test in less time will receive a higher rank.
  • The top 20 participants will qualify for Round 2.

Round 2: The Auction Arena

  • Each finalist will receive 1,000 virtual coins to participate in the coding problem auction.
  • Coding problems will be presented for bidding.
  • The highest bidder will get the opportunity to solve the selected coding problem.
  • Participants must submit a correct solution within the allotted time.
  • Successful solutions will earn rewards according to the event rules.
  • If a participant submits an incorrect solution or fails to solve the problem within the allotted time, the bid amount will be forfeited.
  • Unsolved problems may be offered again through re-auction at the organizers' discretion.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to eligible college students as specified in the official registration details.
  • Participants should have a basic understanding of C programming.
  • Participation is on an individual basis.

Rules and Guidelines

  • Round 1 will consist of 20 C programming MCQs.
  • Qualification will be based on the number of correct answers, with completion time used as the tie-breaker.
  • Only the top 20 participants will qualify for Round 2.
  • Each finalist will receive 1,000 virtual coins at the beginning of the Auction Arena.
  • Participants must bid strategically on the available coding problems.
  • The highest bidder will get the opportunity to solve the selected problem.
  • Incorrect or unsolved problems within the allotted time will result in the forfeiture of the bid amount.
  • Rewards will be distributed according to the announced event rules.
  • Unsolved problems may be re-auctioned at the organizers' discretion.
  • Plagiarism, unauthorized assistance, and other unfair practices are strictly prohibited.
  • Participants must complete both Unstop and Google Form registrations.
  • The organizers' decisions regarding scoring, qualification, and event conduct will be final.

Why Participate?

  • Compete for a total prize pool of ₹7,000.
  • Test your C programming knowledge and logical thinking.
  • Experience a unique combination of coding and strategic bidding.
  • Challenge yourself to solve problems under time pressure.
  • Showcase your programming skills and compete with fellow coding enthusiasts.

Get Ready to Enter the Arena!

Think Fast. Bid Wisely. Code Correctly.

One Arena. Twenty Finalists. ₹7,000 in Prizes.

Complete both registrations and get ready to compete!
